claim.text: A project crawl is constrained to one origin, obeys applicable robots rules across queue entries and redirects, records URL-scoped observations/findings, respects page/time/request budgets, and surfaces persisted coverage limits.

payload.challenge: The gate checks migration 0027 on PG_SOCKET_DIR/PGDATABASE, but it neither rejects nor unsets DATABASE_URL. apps/api createStores prefers DATABASE_URL, and the PostgreSQL crawl integration test calls buildApp({driver: postgres}) without an explicit connection override; Turbo runs in loose env mode. Thus the recorded suite can test a different database than the disposable database whose migration the gate checked. The capture does not bind the API test DB target, so it cannot establish the required disposable-DB gate condition.
